description_zh: 查询用户可用实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi query-available-instances --biz-region cn-hangzhou --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type Subscription --instance-ids rm-xxxxxxxxxxxx --end-time-start 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z --end-time-end 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z --create-time-start 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z --create-time-end 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z --renew-status AutoRenewal --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAvailableInstances

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20. The maximum value is 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认值为20，最大不超过300个
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The product code. You can call the **QueryProductList** operation to query the product code.

> Required when you specify the Region parameter
parameters.help_zh:
产品代码。可通过接口**QueryProductList**查询产品代码。

> 当设置了region时，不为空
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type.

- Subscription: subscription

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。多个ID用英文逗号分隔，最大不超过100个
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the end time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间段起，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式，例如2016-05-23T12:00:00Z
parameters.name: end_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the end time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间段止，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式，例如2016-05-23T12:00:00Z
parameters.name: end_time_end

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the creation time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 创建时间段起，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the creation time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format
parameters.help_zh: 创建时间段止，符合ISO8601标准的utc时间格式
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en:
The renewal status. Valid values:

- AutoRenewal: auto-renewal

- ManualRenewal: manual renewal

- NotRenewal: no renewal
parameters.help_zh:
续费状态，取值：
- AutoRenewal：自动续费。
- ManualRenewal：手动续费。
- NotRenewal：不续费
parameters.name: renew_status
